scope_caveat: Real trip_count reflects ALL Manhattan street traffic (residents + commuters + tourists + commercial); our simulated population is Manhattan RESIDENTS ONLY (same scope mismatch does not affect the mode-choice validation, which compares residents vs residents on both sides) - so a raw KLD on absolute counts is not a fair test of the model. Rank-based metrics below are a fairer read of what a resident-only simulation could plausibly be expected to capture.

top_decile_overlap.note: chance baseline for top-X% overlap is X% itself; near-chance at top 10% (dominated by major arteries/through-traffic) but above-chance from 25% up (more local/resident-driven streets)
